page.help: Mewvo writes down what happens in the server in a log channel: deleted and edited messages, members joining and leaving, role changes and more. Staff can look back later. You can also change these with /logging in Discord. The list of punishments (the mod log) is set on Enforcement & appeals.

modLog.title: Mod log
modLog.text: The mod log lists every warn, mute, kick and ban. It goes to {channel}. You can {change}. Ticket logs are set on {tickets}.

channels.title: Channels
channels.help: Where each kind of log goes. Picking a channel turns logging on.
channels.moderation: Moderation (purge, lock, slowmode…; bans and warns go to the mod log)

forums.title: Advanced logs (forum)
forums.help: Normal: logs go to the channel above. Advanced: logs go to a forum channel with one post per member, so you can search a member and see everything about them in one place.
forums.forumHelp: Used only when Advanced is picked.
forums.tickets: Tickets (transcripts and reviews, one post per member)

tip.title: How advanced logs work
tip.step1: Create a forum channel in Discord and let Mewvo see it, create posts and send messages in posts.
tip.step2: Pick Advanced for a kind of log, choose the forum and save.
tip.step3: Mewvo makes one post per member, named "username logs user ID", and adds every log about them there. Logs about no member go to a "Server logs" post.
tip.step4: To find someone, open the forum and search their name or user ID.
tip.step5: If the forum cannot be used, the logs go to the normal channel of that kind, so nothing is lost.
tip.hidden: This how-to will not show again.

events.title: Events
events.help: Pick which things get logged. Open a group to see its events. Unticking the whole group turns every event in it off.

ignore.title: Ignore lists
ignore.help: Nothing is logged from these channels (and their threads), from members with these roles, or from these members. Useful for bot channels or staff areas.

action.label: Logging

action.ignoringChannel: Ignoring that channel in the logs.
action.ignoringRole: Ignoring that role in the logs.
action.ignoringUser: Ignoring that user in the logs.
action.badId: That is not a valid ID (a long number).
action.notListed: It was not on the list.
